blind.description: A stylized wooden duty roster or pigeonhole organizer featuring a gabled decorative top, side pillars, four narrow shelves packed with small colored canisters/scrolls (cream, maroon, and green), and four hanging wooden tags or tablets across the bottom row. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly modeled in a stylized fantasy or low-poly aesthetic, resting directly on the ground on its integrated side base blocks.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal brown rectangular strip with small square post caps on the ends and middle, casting a tall diagonal shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide.
